notes.title: Small hotfix.
notes.content:
The first time you run the game after the update, the game settings will be reset. This is a necessary measure due to a change in the save file, sorry :(

List of changes:
[list]
[*] Fixed the appearance of anomalies in the final part of the game.
[*] Added mouse sensitivity adjustment.
[*] Fixed several visual bugs.
[/list]

tags.bug: [*] Fixed the appearance of anomalies in the final part of the game.
